verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics export via an OpenTelemetry AI Policy for LLM/MCP/A2A traffic, standardized log formats for analytics aggregation, and explicit guidance that logs and metrics can be gathered and analyzed via Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool, plus local error log file access. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of trace export (spans, not just metrics/logs) and third-party validation of integration with external observability stacks (e.g., Datadog/Grafana) beyond first-party docs.
